title: End of the An Lushan Rebellion
shortSummary: The end of warfare around 763 did not restore the pre-war order but opened a long restructuring of finance, regional power and institutions.
curatorialDescription: The timeline separates the end of war from its institutional consequences rather than equating an end date with recovery.
researchNote: Regional recovery and institutional effects require local histories and material evidence.
